tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Page background: the open air by day, the deep sky by night. Let it take most of the screen.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, inputs, dialogs, sitting on mist.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on mist, paper, sky, meadow or dawn (13:1 or more on mist in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on mist or paper (5.9:1 day, 8.3:1 night).

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Mountain grey for hairlines, borders and dividers (4.59:1 day, 5.5:1 night on mist). Can carry quiet text like placeholders; prefer ink-muted for words.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Primary brand green: the main action, links, selected states. Text on it: on-forest (6.3:1 day, 8.8:1 night).

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a forest fill.

tokens.name: meadow
tokens.usage: Soft green tint: tags, quiet success, highlights. Text on it: ink; forest also passes (4.6:1).

tokens.name: river
tokens.usage: Accent blue: information, secondary links, focus rings (5.0:1 day on mist). Text on it: on-river.

tokens.name: on-river
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a river fill.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Horizon tint: wide backgrounds for intros, info callouts and empty states. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Warm gold of the sun in the logo: stars, highlights, warning icons. A graphic colour (3.8:1 day on mist); never for small text by day.

tokens.name: dawn
tokens.usage: Warm tint for gentle warnings and featured moments. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only, as text, icon or border (5.4:1 day, 7.8:1 night on mist).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the opening line of a landing or lesson.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Reading text. Keep lines near 70 characters.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Padding inside buttons and inputs; gap between related items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between groups of content.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between page sections. Be generous: space is part of the message.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Hero and landscape breaks: the far view at the top of a page.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, callouts, images: soft like a worn stone.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags and avatars; the shape of hills.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: The only shadow: a card lifted by the light. Prefer space and stone hairlines first.
